message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and let me tell you, it was quite the comedy show in our house! I stumbled around looking for flashlights, only to find one with dead batteries and another buried under a pile of old blankets. My phone was down to 5%, and I realized I hadn’t charged my portable power bank in ages. We ended up playing charades by the glow of our phone screens, laughing about how unprepared we were. It was a fun reminder that a little planning can turn a minor inconvenience into a memorable night. How do you keep the mood light when things go dark?
